info.name: Demand Accounts Profiling Quotas By Supplier API
Retrieves the supplier distribution for a profile

params.name: project_id
params.description: A unique identifier for the project, in ULID format.

params.name: target_group_id
params.description: A unique identifier for the target group, in ULID format.

params.name: profile_id
params.description: The character string representing a unique profile ID (ULID format).

items.docs: Retrieves a profile's quota structure, including the projected distribution of completes across different suppliers based on historical data. You can use this data to understand how your quotas are likely to be filled.

info.name: Calculates the supplier distribution for a new target group

items.docs:
Calculates the projected distribution of completes across different suppliers for a new, unsaved target group configuration.

You can use this endpoint to understand how your proposed quotas are likely to be filled by different panel sources.

**Note:** Providing supplier allocation details in the request is not yet supported but is planned for a future release.

The API automatically removes duplicate open-ended values in this request before calculating the distribution, but rejects duplicates
